Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner turn after the initial analysis), the Planner incorrectly identified the father-in-law of Maria Luisa of Savoy (specifically Marie Thérèse Louise, Princesse de Lamballe) as "Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon, Duke of Penthièvre." This is factually incorrect; the father of Louis Alexandre de Bourbon (Prince of Lamballe) is Louis de Bourbon-Toulouse, Duke of Penthièvre (Louis Jean Marie was a different generation). The Planner also hallucinated a connection between the Princesse de Lamballe and the Grand Dauphin lineage in the same turn, confusing the two distinct historical figures (Maria Luisa Gabriella and Maria Luisa Teresa). This fundamental error in genealogical fact led the entire subsequent search strategy to be based on a wrong name.
